## Summary

What changed, and why a user of rcp would care.

## Tests

The command that showed this works, and what it reported. A failing test is a finding
until a cause is shown.

## Notes

- [ ] Title is a Conventional Commit (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `test`, `ci`, `chore`, `perf`, `refactor`, `build`). The title becomes the commit on `main`.
- [ ] No new secret, credential, or private address in fixtures, docs, or logs.
